method: Position-only control: always choose actionId 1 (the second move in the current complete legal-action menu); if only one legal action, execute automatically. No board analysis, search, or model.
notes: Separate process; does not mutate active HTTP games.
Active browser server did not fix PYTHONHASHSEED, so set-derived menu ordering may differ across processes.
This run uses on-disk catan-compact-v2 observations, but this policy ignores the observation prompt entirely.
CPU simulation time excludes inference and is not comparable to model decision latency.
